card.name: Partway into drug names, and 'not'
card.fires_on: Responds to the start or middle of a drug name (for example B in a brand name, or the end of acetate or moxifloxacin) after a verb like discontinue, take, or dosage of. Also fires on 'not' after is or do in reassurance or negation statements.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: The first letter or an inner piece of a drug name right after a verb or preposition such as take, discontinue, or of.
modes.example: Take<< B>>IXLENVO and supplements or antac

modes.label: Negation word
modes.description: The word 'not' after is or do, stating that something is normal or does not respond.
modes.example: This is a normal reaction to the dye and is<< not>> a cause for concern.

card.plain: It lights up when a drug name is being spelled out in pieces, and sometimes on the word 'not'.
